title: TDS: Improve version detection
description:
Only set the version the first time through the capture, to avoid
issues with random packet access.

Separate out the function that sets the TDS version directly from
the TDS version from the function that sets the TDS version from
the program version, used in TDS7 PreLogin packets. Only with MS SQL
Server 7.0 are the versions close to identical, and this makes
comparisons easier.

Instead of assuming that the latest version supported by the server
is used, use the minimum of the maximum versions supported by both
server and client as the expected negotiated version. Note that with
some unusual captures we might get the response before the request.
The capture attached to !9530 has an example where the client only
supports an earlier version of TDS than the server does, the client
LOGIN7 message is over TLS and not decrypted, and the server response
to the LOGIN7 has a version-dependent Info token before the LoginAck
token that confirms the TDS version.
